proposals.title: TO CONSIDER A SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING POLITICAL CONTRIBUTIONS DISCLOSURE
proposals.proponent: Mercy A. Rome, c/o Newground Social Investment
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a semiannually updated report disclosing policies and expenditures for political campaign contributions, including recipients, amounts, and responsible decision-makers, excluding lobbying.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the Proposal and asks shareholders to read through NIKE's response
